{{UnitInfobox |image-static = SunflowerIcon.png |image-dynamic = SunflowerDynamic.png |pseudoxd = true |source = [[Biologist]] |level = 5 |type = Plant |lifespan = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Lifespan]]20s |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]50 |spawnrate = [[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]20s |damage_type = Single |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]6 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]1.1 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]15 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Unit Level 2+}} |lead = N/A |flying = N/A }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Deals high single target dps.|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== The '''Sunflower''' is spawned by the [[Biologist]]. The [[Biologist]] is able to spawn the '''Sunflower''' throughout all Levels, as long as it selected in the unit queue. It spawns on ground within the [[Biologist]]'s range. The '''Sunflower's''' statistics are increased as the [[Biologist]] is upgraded. Unlike the other [[Biologist]], this plant does not apply any additional effects, though it deals the highest DPS out of all the plants. It will target a single enemy in its range and deal damage to it. After 20 seconds have passed, it will disappear from the map and the [[Biologist]] will replace it with another plant. ==Appearance== The '''Sunflower''' is a sunflower that fires lasers. It has yellow and orange petals. Its stem and leaf is green. ==Statistics== {{neow| $DPS$ = Damage / Firerate $MDPS$ = $DPS$ * Unit Queue $MREF$ = DPS is multiplied by the '''Biologist's''' unit queues.

}} ==Strategy== *The '''Sunflower''' can be effective against singular enemies that spawn, due to its high DPS. *Other [[Biologist]] plants, like the [[Ivy]] or [[Nightshade (Unit)|Nightshade]], can be helpful with the '''Sunflower''', as their ability to stall enemies gives the '''Sunflower''' more time to kill them. *As the '''Sunflower''' has hidden detection, it can be used to deal with [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies. ==Sounds== {{Sounds| {{WeaponHeader|All skins}}{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- |[[File:DefaultSunflowerFire.ogg]] |Firing sound |}}} }} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Ducky Battlepass - Tower Defense Simulator|Default skin on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SunflowerIconIG.png|In-game icon. }} ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Sunflower''' added. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **Firerate decreased due to the [[Firerate Bug]] getting fixed. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Firerate decreased from 1.125 to 1.1. ***'''Level 1''' ****Firerate decreased from 1.125 to 1.1. ***'''Level 2''' ****Firerate decreased from 1.125 to 1.1. ***'''Level 3''' ****Firerate decreased from 1.025 to 1. ***'''Level 4''' ****Firerate decreased from 0.825 to 0.8. ==Notes== {{TowerNavBox}}
